# Outcomes

This engagement will enable PURE FINANCIAL ADVISORS LLC to achieve a step-change in pipeline visibility and marketing effectiveness by delivering integrated Lead-to-AUM and Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) reporting. Leveraging automated data processes and enhanced Power BI dashboards, the project will provide measurable improvements in the accuracy, granularity, and timeliness of business insights. These outcomes will empower leadership and marketing teams to make data-driven decisions that optimize acquisition strategies and maximize return on investment.

## Expected Business Outcomes

- **Granular Pipeline Insights:** Advanced reporting will deliver detailed analytics on the full lead journey, supporting improved management of the lead-to-AUM pipeline and helping to identify bottlenecks and opportunities for growth.

- **Marketing ROI Visibility:** Automated and precise CAC metrics will furnish leadership with clear views of the effectiveness of marketing spend, supporting optimization of budget allocations and campaign strategies.

- **Actionable KPI Dashboards:** Power BI dashboards, refreshed through automated data pipelines, will provide up-to-date and accurate visualizations of key performance indicators, including lead-to-AUM conversion rates and acquisition costs.

- **Improved Data-Driven Decision-Making:** Senior leadership will gain instant access to granular insights, enhancing the ability to evaluate customer acquisition tactics, refine targeting, and rapidly adapt to market changes.

- **Scalable Reporting Foundation:** The flexible data model and integration design will position PURE FINANCIAL ADVISORS LLC to effortlessly add future data sources and reporting domains, strengthening the company’s data maturity and operational scalability.

- **Reduced Manual Reporting Effort:** Automated data ingestion and transformation reduce time spent on manual reporting, ensuring timely and consistent analytics available for all stakeholder groups.

Success of this initiative will be measured by the accuracy and integration of L2A and CAC reporting; adoption of automated dashboards by business and marketing teams; and demonstrable improvements in pipeline conversion and marketing performance visibility.
